title: Grilled Apple and Syrian Delight
description: A sweet and savory dessert that combines the crunch of grilled apples with the nutty flavors of Syrian cuisine. This perfect dessert for fall and winter seasons.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the apples into wedges and brush with a little bit of oil.
3. Grill the apples for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they have a nice char.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the Syrian olives and nutty granola.
5. Dip each grilled apple wedge into the chocolate and then into the olive-granola mixture.
6. Place the coated apple wedges on a serving plate and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
